author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring Freelance Artists for Character Design, Illustrations, and Backgrounds
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: -Character Design & Illustration -Character Sprites -Background & Environment Art -Webtoon / Comic Artwork -Game & Digital Art Assets -Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya. Kualifikasi: Memiliki portofolio yang kuat dan dasar menggambar yang baik, Mampu mengikuti art direction yang telah ditentukan atau beradaptasi dengan berbagai gaya visual, Memahami anatomi, komposisi, dan penggunaan warna dengan baik, Mampu menyelesaikan pekerjaan sesuai dengan deadline proyek, Terbiasa menerima feedback dan melakukan revisi, Memiliki komunikasi profesional dan etos kerja yang dapat diandalkan. Cara Melamar: Bagi Anda yang tertarik untuk bergabung sebagai freelance artist, silakan kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke: avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com Gunakan subject email: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Dalam email, Anda juga dapat mencantumkan: Jenis artwork yang Anda kuasai atau minati, Art style yang biasa Anda gunakan, Ketersediaan untuk mengerjakan proyek, Rate freelance. Artist yang terpilih akan dihubungi untuk kesempatan berkolaborasi pada proyek-proyek freelance mendatang bersama Avetetsuya Studios.

author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range. Who we're looking for: An emerging illustrator ready to earn their first picture book credit, or add a strong title to an existing portfolio. You need to draw the same characters, animals, and settings again and again, different scenes, different angles, and keep them recognizable every time. Strong sequential storytelling across full spreads. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones (signing / approved thumbnails & character designs / approved finished illustrations / print-ready delivery). Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. Future books come with paid commissions and the opportunity to negotiate ongoing royalty participation. Prominent cover and title-page credit. Timeline: Hire by November 1, 2026; Thumbnails ~December 15; Finished art ~February 1, 2027; Print-ready ~March 1, 2027. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Sealious Seal
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon (Garchomp and Lucario)
content: LF people who can draw Pokemon. You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario. I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style, place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS! This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too! MOP: GCash, like always. Contact via comments on the post.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST. Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!
